title: AgentAction
description: One complete decision cycle, persisted. This is the audit trail AND the demo: the dApp feed renders these as 'data consulted → reasoning → transaction'. Recorded even when the agent holds or fails, because a curator that did nothing and said why is still curating.

status.description: 'rejected' = the model's output failed schema or mandate-constraint validation and never reached the chain. Keep these: they are evidence the validation layer is load-bearing.

snapshot.description: Exactly what the agent could see. Stored whole so a decision is reproducible after the fact.

mandate_version_after.description: Differs from _before only when the agent amended its own mandate this tick.

validation_retries.description: How many malformed outputs were rejected before a valid one. Worth surfacing — it is the honest cost of small open models.
